chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Sinān, from Ḥafṣ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked him about one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating. He said: He should give charity of one dīnār and seek forgiveness from Allah, Exalted is He.

key_terms.بِدِينَارٍ: with one dīnār, the specified amount of charity

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a man who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who has intercourse with his wife during menstruation. It prescribes an expiation of giving one dīnār in charity along with seeking forgiveness from Allah, indicating both a legal and moral response to the violation.
